newsitem.title: USA: Glencore's Brent cargoes entrance weak U.S. crudes.
newsitem.headline: Glencore's Brent cargoes entrance weak U.S. crudes.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes remained weak in late Monday trading, fixated on the fate of six cargoes of North Sea Brent set to load March 10 for the U.S.
Traders said the chance nearly six cargoes were headed to the Gulf depressed sweet domestic grades.

Swiss-based Glencore had fixed a pair of Ultra Large Crude Carriers, reportedly set to load the Marine Atlantic with 2.85 million barrels of Brent for U.S. destinations. But, many cash traders doubted the crude would make it to the Gulf.
"My gut feeling is that it will not get to the Gulf. They will get raped by refiners looking to buy cheap," a trader.
